title: 「to + 動詞」句型

source.file: Sentence Structure 1 - 「to + 動詞」表達目的.pdf

formula: Subject + action + to + base verb + other information

formulas.formula: Subject + action + to + base verb + other information

examples.en: I want to go to school to learn something challenging.
examples.zh: 我想去上學，去學一些有挑戰性的東西。

example: I want to go to school to learn something challenging.
exampleZh: 我想去上學，去學一些有挑戰性的東西。

rules.en: Always use the base form of the verb after to.
rules.zh: to 後面必須使用動詞原形。

rules.en: Keep the tense in the main action; the purpose verb after to does not change.
rules.zh: 時態應保留在主要動作；to 後面的目的動詞不會隨時態改變。

rules.en: Remove repeated reason words such as because, so that or in order that when you rewrite the sentence.
rules.zh: 改寫時，應刪去重複表達原因或目的的 because、so that 或 in order that。

rules.en: Keep all important information from the original sentence and begin with the word provided.
rules.zh: 答案須保留原句的重要資料，並使用題目提供的第一個字開始。

benefits.en: This structure shows the purpose of an action clearly and directly.
benefits.zh: 這個句型能清楚直接地說明一個動作的目的。

benefits.en: It combines an action and its reason into one shorter, smoother sentence.
benefits.zh: 它能把一個動作和背後原因合併成一句更精簡、更流暢的句子。

benefits.en: It helps you vary your sentence structure instead of repeatedly using because or so that.
benefits.zh: 它能增加句式變化，避免反覆使用 because 或 so that。

sourceOmissions: The PDF does not contain separate Important Rules or Benefits sections; these two bilingual teaching pages are editorial additions based on the exercise pattern.
